findings.issue: Varying title lengths (1 vs 2 lines) cause elements below the title (prices, stock status, and 'Add to basket' buttons) to vertically misalign across columns in the same row.
findings.user_impact: Disrupts horizontal scanning of prices and actions, making the page feel cluttered and unprofessional.
findings.recommendation: Apply a flexbox layout to the card container (`display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%;`) and use `margin-top: auto;` on the bottom section containing the price, stock status, and button to force them to align perfectly to the bottom baseline.

findings.issue: Extremely tight vertical padding and line-height on the long list of category links (over 50 items stacked tightly).
findings.user_impact: Increases the risk of mis-clicks (especially on touch devices) and makes scanning the list visually exhausting.
findings.recommendation: Increase the vertical padding of the sidebar list items (`padding: 6px 12px;` or `line-height: 1.6`) to provide adequate breathing room and target size.

findings.issue: The light grey subtitle text on the light blue-grey header background has insufficient contrast, falling below the WCAG AA 4.5:1 threshold.
findings.user_impact: Low-vision users or users in high-glare environments will struggle to read this brand subtitle.
findings.recommendation: Darken the subtitle text color to a darker grey (e.g., `#555555` or `#333333`) to guarantee a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the light background.
